title: decisions write side (log, supersede, redact) on the ported D9 lock, incl. mjs-vs-rust lock conformance
action: Port the decisions WRITE path: log, supersede, redact (handlers at packages/bee/bee.mjs:1924-2229 (REVIEW-CORRECTED: handleDecisionsLog starts at 1924; the old start landed 16 lines inside its body); lib at packages/bee/lib/decisions.mjs). Extend the existing crates/bee-core/src/decisions.rs (today read-only, 243 LOC) rather than adding a parallel module. Every append is wrapped in withDecisionsLockSync (decisions.mjs:89, call sites :336,:484,:507,:638) -- consume the already-ported D9 protocol in crates/bee-core/src/lock.rs, do not reimplement it. Event objects are JSON.stringify'd from literals with a fixed field order (decisions.mjs:219,245) so serde_json preserve_order is load-bearing; a key-order drift is a red. Content passes through bee-core::datamark from rpl-3. Redaction semantics and the citation sweep that queues capture stubs (packages/bee/bee.mjs:1980) must be preserved. LOCK CONFORMANCE (D7c) is this cell's own obligation and cannot be seen by output diffing: add a concurrency test in the shape of packages/bee/tests/race_decisions_child.mjs where a live mjs writer and the Rust binary append concurrently to the same .bee/decisions.jsonl -- assert zero lost updates, zero interleaved partial lines, and a .bee/logs/contention.jsonl shape identical to what two mjs writers produce. Register --cmd-check scenarios for each verb incl. supersede of an absent id, redact of an already-redacted id, and log with adversarial content. REVIEW NOTE: `.bee/logs` is in the tree-diff exclusion set (crates/bee-parity/src/differ.rs:28), so the contention.jsonl shape truth is NOT provable through --cmd-check — prove it inside the conformance test by reading the file directly after the race. Also assert the decisions unknown-verb usage fallback line (packages/bee/bee.mjs:6586-6609).

truths: cargo test -p bee-core --test decisions_lock_conformance passes, with the mixed mjs/rust concurrent-writer case reporting zero lost appends over at least 50 rounds
cargo run --release --manifest-path crates/Cargo.toml -p bee-parity -- --cmd-check --group decisions reports every decisions write scenario clean, appended line byte-identical incl. key order
contention.jsonl entries produced by the Rust writer are shape-identical to mjs-produced ones
adversarial log content is neutralized identically to mjs
the decisions unknown-verb usage fallback line is byte-identical to mjs

the workspace test run at the head of this cell verify is green with --no-fail-fast, so no cross-cutting pin has rotted outside every cell own gate (the rpl-3 goal-check found one that had been false for two cells because it sat outside every verify and was never executed)
